mentions.name: Little Free Library
mentions.description: A Little Free Library — a small outdoor book-sharing box the author is building outside their home to share a love of reading and trade books with neighbors.
mentions.source_excerpt: Once my visiting family departs I am going to finish building the Little Free Library I started last month. We have lived in our current home for 5 years and it is about time I share my love of reading with my neighbors.
